p3-p1-27.actual: Parent My bookings: the listing-detail effect depended on its own result state, so every response re-requested every listing still in flight. A family with ~65 past listings fired hundreds of GET /api/listings/:id, filled the browser's 6 sockets, and the refetch after 'Accept the place' queued 15s+ behind them - the card kept showing the offer although the server had confirmed it (waitlist loop e2e failed 3/3 with this).
p3-p1-27.notes: Each listing is fetched once, live bookings first, 4 at a time. Commit 8c1fb95c. Trace evidence: /tmp/p1/tr3 trace (65 listing GETs twice, post-accept GET delayed to +14s). Re-run of the waitlist spec after the fix is in entry 28.

p3-p1-28.actual: booking-lifecycle waitlist loop (waitlisted -> operator offers -> parent accepts -> Confirmed) failed 3/3 before the My bookings fetch fix and passes after it (30s).
